bugs.error_message: OpeningEntryAccountError: Difference Account must be a Asset/Liability type account, since this Stock Reconciliation is an Opening Entry
bugs.root_cause: set_item_qty set sr.difference_account, but the Stock Reconciliation field is named expense_account (label 'Difference Account'). The account was therefore never applied and validation failed on opening-stock items.
bugs.fix: Set sr.expense_account (not sr.difference_account) to the company's 'Temporary Opening' account (an Asset account, valid for both opening and non-opening reconciliations).

bugs.error_message: Item Manager SPA shows 'Failed to load items' with a Retry button
bugs.root_cause: The /item-manager www page is public (not auth-gated) so a logged-out visitor can open it, but every whitelisted API call (get_items) then returns PermissionError. The SPA rendered a dead-end error state instead of routing to login.
bugs.fix: Added isAuthError() + redirectToLogin() helpers; items resource onError redirects to /login?redirect-to=<path> on a PermissionError/AuthenticationError, and the error state shows a 'Log in' button for auth errors.

bugs.error_message: Item Manager SPA shows "Failed to load items" for logged-in users
bugs.root_cause: No www page controller existed, so window.csrf_token was never injected; frappe-ui frappeRequest sent no X-Frappe-CSRF-Token header and POST to get_items failed with CSRFTokenError (HTTP 400) for desk-logged-in users who have a saved csrf_token.
bugs.fix: Added www controller item_manager.py (basename scrubbed: hyphen->underscore) with get_context that sets context.boot.csrf_token via frappe.sessions.get_csrf_token(), and redirects Guest sessions to /login.
